info.title: LearnWise API
info.description: Turns your lecture PDFs/slides into grounded answers, notes, quizzes, flashcards and graded mock exams.

post.summary: Ask a question about your material (RAG), with follow-up memory
post.description:
Pipeline: [rewrite a follow-up] -> retrieve -> fenced context -> generate -> verify -> retry once -> flag.

The history only helps understand the question; the answer is verified against the passages retrieved now.

post.summary: Read text aloud with the AI voice (WAV audio)

501.description: AI voice is off (mock mode or no TTS_BASE_URL): use the browser's voice

502.description: The voice server failed: use the browser's voice

post.summary: Generate concise, detailed or exam notes
Submit answers, get score and feedback
Generate a personalised, graded mock exam
Submit the exam, get marks, grade and feedback

get.summary: The marked result of a submitted exam
Past exam grades for a student

post.summary: Mind map / flowchart of the topics in your material

get.summary: Mastery per topic and quiz history

document_ids.title: Document Ids
document_ids.description: Limit search to these documents; null = all

history.title: History
history.description: Earlier exchanges, oldest first. Only the last ASK_HISTORY_TURNS are used, to understand what a follow-up refers to; never as a source of facts

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: The standalone question the follow-up was rewritten to and searched with; null when the question was searched as asked

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: false when no relevant passage was found and the model says so, or when the answer failed the citation/support check against its passages (VERIFY_ANSWERS)

AskTurn.title: AskTurn
AskTurn.description: One earlier exchange of the chat, sent back by the frontend so follow-ups like "why is that?" work.

options.title: Options
options.description: Exactly 4 options for mcq, null for short

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: Marks available: 1 per MCQ, 3 per short answer

missing_points.title: Missing Points
missing_points.description: Short answers: key points the student left out

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topics to cover; null = personalised pick (weak topics first, then unseen document topics)

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: 'adaptive' sets difficulty per topic from the student's mastery

ExamResponse.title: ExamResponse
ExamResponse.description: Answers are NOT included. Submit to get marks and feedback.

ExamTopicPlan.title: ExamTopicPlan
ExamTopicPlan.description: How the exam was personalised for one topic, shown to the student before they start.

llm_reachable.title: Llm Reachable
llm_reachable.description: null when mock mode skips the check

tts_mode.title: Tts Mode
tts_mode.description: ai = /api/speech uses the AI voice on the gateway; browser = the frontend reads answers with the browser's voice

MindMapLink.title: MindMapLink
MindMapLink.description: A cross-link between two nodes on different branches (drawn dashed), e.g. 'provides gradients for'.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One sentence from the material, shown when the node is clicked

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Centre of the map. null or empty = map the whole document(s)

max_nodes.title: Max Nodes
max_nodes.description: Most nodes in the map, root included

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The requested topic; null for a whole-document map

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Tree in breadth-first order: root first, then each level

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this topic was picked, shown to the student

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: A fresh, simpler explanation of the topic

weak_topics.title: Weak Topics
weak_topics.description: Topics with mastery below 0.6, weakest first

score.title: Score
score.description: 1 for correct mcq; partial credit possible for short answers

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: For mcq: the option index as a string ('0'-'3'). For short: free text.

options.title: Options
options.description: Exactly 4 options for mcq, null for short

QuizResponse.title: QuizResponse
QuizResponse.description: Answers are NOT included, so the frontend cannot leak them. Submit to get them.

chunk_id.title: Chunk Id
chunk_id.description: Chunk id; merged passages join their chunk ids with '+'

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The retrieved passage text: one chunk (up to ~800 characters), or neighbouring chunks of the same page merged into one passage

score.title: Score
score.description: Similarity score, higher is more relevant (0-1)

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: A passage from an uploaded document that supports the answer.

text.title: Text
text.description: Answer text; [S1]-style citations are removed before speaking

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice, e.g. af_heart; null = TTS_VOICE
